Client.Name: US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration

Project.Brief history of your project and organi: The NOAA GraphCastGFS is an experimental medium-range global weather forecasting model developed by NOAA’s National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP). Built on Google DeepMind’s GraphCast machine learning framework, it uses a message-passing graph neural network (GNN) with an encoder-processor-decoder architecture on an icosahedral grid. The model is initialized with NCEP’s 0.25° GDAS analysis data and fine-tuned using ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis as ground truth.It generates forecasts from current and 6-hour-prior states, outputting key atmospheric and surface variables (temperature, wind components, geopotential height, specific humidity, vertical velocity) across 13 vertical levels (v2/v2.1; v2 removed 37-layer version for efficiency). Forecasts are produced at 6-hour intervals, up to 10 days (v2.1 extends to 16 days from July 10, 2024 06Z), with four daily cycles (00Z, 06Z, 12Z, 18Z) at ~28 km resolution.Data is stored in AWS Open Data (S3 bucket: noaa-nws-graphcastgfs-pds, us-east-1) in GRIB2 (forecasts) and NetCDF (inputs), accessible without an AWS account via CLI (aws s3 ls --no-sign-request) or browser. New data notifications are available via SNS.Applications include agriculture, disaster response, climate monitoring, and research. NOAA data is CC0; model weights (v2) follow CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Documentation: https://graphcastgfs.readthedocs.io.
Project.Describe the data being stored onto File: GraphCastGFS is NCEP’s experimental medium-range global forecast system with 0.25° latitude-longitude resolution (~28 km). It runs four cycles daily (00Z, 06Z, 12Z, 18Z), delivering 6-hourly forecasts up to 10 days in GRIB2 format. Key fields include temperature, wind components, geopotential height, specific humidity, and vertical velocity.Built on Google DeepMind’s pre-trained GraphCast MLWP model, it uses an encoder-processor-decoder graph neural network on an icosahedral grid with ~37 million parameters, trained on ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis. Initialized with current and 6-hour-prior NCEP GDAS 0.25° analysis states, it runs 37-level GraphCast and 13-level GraphCast_operational versions. Unit conversions ensure output consistency with GFS products.

Third, I will deliver the CAR files to the Storage Provider via hard drives or secure network transfer, ensuring compliance with CC0 and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licences.
